chunks: Or did they not recognise their apostle, and rejected him?
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the Quran says 'Or did they not recognise their apostle?'
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as addressing the specific denial of the Prophet's divine appointment and his Ahl al-Bayt, emphasizing that rejection stems from spiritual blindness rather than mere ignorance. It underscores the logical inconsistency of those who claim to follow the message yet reject the Messenger himself, a theme central to the concept of Imamate. The verse serves as a reminder that true recognition (ma'rifah) of the Prophet entails acceptance of his authority and guidance.
